criteria.requirement: Implement ftfy.streaming.fix_chunks(chunks,config=None,*,max_line_length=1000000). Assemble physical LF lines across arbitrary Unicode chunk boundaries (including CRLF and mojibake sequences), then use actual fix_file semantics including sticky auto-HTML policy across lines. Preserve final unterminated line, ignore empty chunks, stay lazy and buffer at most one bounded physical line. Validate positive character budget/config before consuming input, reject non-text chunks and over-budget lines before repairing them. Results must equal fix_file(StringIO(joined_input)) without materializing the full input or changing old fix_file.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
